ctaHeading: Newport's concreters are ready — let's pour your project.
aboutText: Located at 35 Gordon St, Newport, B&D Concreting has been the go-to concreting contractor for over 25 years. We offer a full range of services including plain concreting, coloured concrete, exposed aggregate, driveways, slabs, and foundations. Serving suburbs like Altona, Williamstown, and Footscray, we pride ourselves on reliable, professional work for both domestic and commercial clients.
servicesText: At B&D Concreting, we specialise in a wide array of concrete services tailored to your needs. Our offerings include plain and coloured concrete, footpaths, crossovers, steps, and foundations, all delivered with 25 years of expertise. We cater to residential, commercial, and industrial clients across Newport and surrounding areas.

services.title: Driveways and Concrete Slabs
services.desc: Expert installation of durable driveways and slabs for homes and businesses, ensuring a smooth, long-lasting finish.

services.title: Exposed Aggregate Finishes
services.desc: Specialised in exposed aggregate concrete, providing a decorative and slip-resistant surface for pathways and outdoor areas.

services.title: Plain and Coloured Concrete
services.desc: Versatile plain and coloured concrete options for floors, walls, and various applications, with custom colour choices.

services.title: Footpaths and Crossovers
services.desc: Reliable footpath and crossover construction, designed to meet municipal standards and enhance property access.

services.title: Steps, Landings and Foundations
services.desc: Solid foundations and precisely crafted steps and landings for safe, stable structures in any project.

services.title: Industrial & Commercial Repair Work
services.desc: Efficient repair and maintenance services for industrial and commercial concrete structures, minimising downtime.

reviews.text: B&D Concreting did an amazing job on our driveway in Newport. The exposed aggregate finish is perfect, and they finished on time. Highly recommend their services for any concrete work.
reviews.name: Dave Thompson

reviews.text: We hired B&D for footpath repairs at our business in Altona. Their team was professional, and the coloured concrete matches our brand perfectly. Great experience from start to finish.
reviews.name: Sarah Mitchell

reviews.text: As a property manager, I've used B&D Concreting for multiple slab installations across Melbourne's west. Their reliability and quality workmanship make them my go-to concreter for all projects.
reviews.name: Tom O'Brien
